notes: County zoning layer (Planning/CCZoning). Zone_Class is the district code. Jurisdiction attribute is blank for nearly all features (only a few towns such as Eastover, Wade, Spring Lake, Godwin, Hope Mills, Falcon, Stedman, Linden, and COUNTY appear), so it is not mapped. Parcel-based city zoning (e.g. Fayetteville) may not be included.
